prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1121; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of a city street in Pearland, Texas, when the vehicle directly behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper at a speed the officer estimated as moderate. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was transported for evaluation. The damage to both vehicles is consistent with the impact described by the drivers, and the rear panel of Driver 1's vehicle shows crush deformation that matches the point of contact. Photographs taken at the scene support several of the statements given, although no independent witnesses came forward to describe the collision. Officers confirmed through their own observation and statements from both drivers that a passenger was seated in the front right position at the time of impact. Inspection revealed no prior body damage or repair work on the struck vehicle that could be linked to this event. Driver 1 advised that they reside in the same household as the vehicle's named policyholder and share use of the car. Citations were not issued at the scene, and the report will be forwarded for supplemental review.
